# JV Ice Hockey Academy London

> Ice hockey academy at Queens Ice Rink, 17 Queensway, Bayswater, London W2 4QP. Structured coaching for children and adults since 2014. Website: https://jvhockey.com

## Key facts
- Founded: 2014. Company: JV Ice Hockey Academy Ltd (company no. 13464492).
- Founder and head coach: Vid Jazbec.
- Venue: Queens Ice Rink, 17 Queensway, London W2 4QP, Bayswater.
- Children's groups: U7 Learn to Skate, U9, U11, U13, U15, U16, U18 Development. Groups are based on birth year; final placement is confirmed by the academy after registration.
- Children's sessions generally run during school terms on Tuesday after school and Saturday and Sunday mornings.
- Adult hockey: Tuesday (beginners welcome) and Friday (intermediate and advanced).
- Registration for children and adults is through Spond: https://club.spond.com/landing/signup/jvicehockey/
- Contact: info@jvhockey.com or the enquiry form at https://jvhockey.com/contact.html

- [Camps and clinics](https://jvhockey.com/camps-clinics.html): holiday camps and specialist clinics for young players
- [About](https://jvhockey.com/about.html): the academy and coaches
